what_this_is: Claims with a known answer, written from the NIST answer key. The gate must certify the true ones and refuse the false ones. Facts are named by what they are, not by id, so this file survives changes to the extractor.
selectors: A selector picks the lowest-id fact matching kind, obj / obj_endswith, aux and utc (within the reference tolerance).
